item.title: RBI releases the Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2025-26
item.description: The Reserve Bank released the Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, with state-wise data on output, prices, fiscal indicators and outstanding liabilities.

item.title: Money Market Operations as on September 15, 2026
